**Regulation to analyze:** FERC Security Program for Hydropower Projects (Rev. 3A), FERC D2SI Security Program, incl. Section 9 cyber/SCADA and Form 3 Cyber Security Inspection Checklist
**Why:** The only dam-specific federal security program with explicit cyber/SCADA requirements, inspected by FERC D2SI. Hydro generators that are BES assets must also meet NERC CIP; federal (USACE/USBR) dams follow internal federal (FISMA) controls instead.
